relationships.evidence_quote: The qPCR results indicated a significant increase in Fto expression in the SNL group on days 3 and 7 post-surgery compared with that in the control group.

relationships.evidence_quote: Additionally, downregulation of Mettl3 expression was observed in the SNL group on days 3, 7, and 14 post-surgery (p < 0.05).

key_findings: Six m1A/m6A/m5C/m7G regulators (Fto, Mettl3, Nsun2, Ythdf3, Wdr4, Eif4e) were differentially expressed in NP; Fto up and Mettl3, Nsun2, Ythdf3 down in SNL rat.
Two RNA-methylation NP clusters identified with DEGs enriched in MAPK and FoxO pathways.
